[SWS_Eth_00415]
Apply EthCtrlConfigEgressQueueSortingEntry of an
EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue on an Ethernet frame
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00171, SRS_BSW_00350, SRS_BSW_00386
⌈The configured EthCtrlConfigEgressQueueSortingEntry of an EthCtrl-
ConfigEgressQueue shall be applied as filter on an Ethernet frame to identify a
match. If a match is identified, then this Ethernet frame shall be enqueued in the af-
fected EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue.⌋
